privacy.description: How we handle your information when you use our site or contact us.

privacy.collected: Data collected via the contact form
privacy.collectedBody: When you send a message (name, email, subject, content), we use this information only to respond to your request and maintain legitimate relationship follow-up.
privacy.analyticsBody: Depending on the final site configuration, cookies or trackers may be used (see cookie policy). Adapt with your analytics solution or its absence.
privacy.rightsBody: Under applicable regulations, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, or object to certain processing. You may lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: What you should know about trackers that may be placed during your visit.
cookies.whatBody: A cookie is a small file stored on your device when you visit a site. It may serve technical purposes (security, preferences) or audience measurement depending on implementation.
cookies.usedBody: The current showcase site mainly uses cookies necessary for technical operation. Update if you add third-party social embeds, Google Maps, advertising, Matomo / GA4, etc.
cookies.necessaryBody: Proper site operation (e.g. load balancing, language preferences).
cookies.analyticsBody: Only after configuration and, unless exempt, consent (document precisely).
cookies.choicesBody: You can configure your browser to refuse all or part of cookies. For a compliant consent banner (Tarteaucitron, Axeptio, etc.), plan a dedicated integration.
